themes.name: Fried alligator
themes.description: Reviews discussing the fried alligator appetizer, including its texture, chili garlic aioli or mayo sauce, breading and seasoning, and whether it is worth ordering.

themes.name: Wood-fired oysters
themes.description: Reviews discussing the wood-fired or char-grilled oysters with chili garlic butter, including flavor, portion count, price, and how they compare with other oysters in town.

themes.name: Louisiana Cochon entree
themes.description: Reviews about the signature Louisiana Cochon pork dish (pulled pork patty with cabbage, turnips and cracklins), covering its moisture, temperature, and flavor.

themes.name: Rabbit and dumplings
themes.description: Reviews about the rabbit and dumplings entree, including the amount of rabbit, the dumplings, the broth or stew, and the seasoning.

themes.name: Mac and cheese
themes.description: Reviews mentioning the macaroni and cheese casserole side, including creaminess, cheese, and seasoning.

themes.name: Smoked pork ribs
themes.description: Reviews about the smoked or spicy grilled pork ribs with watermelon pickle, including tenderness, sauce, spiciness, and the pickle.

themes.name: Pork cheeks
themes.description: Reviews about the pork cheek dishes, covering tenderness, preparation, garnishes, and portion size.

themes.name: Boudin
themes.description: Reviews about the fried boudin or boudin balls appetizer, including flavor, texture, and accompaniments such as mustard and pickled peppers.

themes.name: Complimentary bread
themes.description: Reviews mentioning the bread rolls and butter served at the table, including their quality and whether refills were provided or denied.

themes.name: Salt and seasoning
themes.description: Reviews commenting on how salty, bland, or well seasoned the food is across dishes, including over-salting and lack of flavor.

themes.name: Waitstaff service
themes.description: Reviews about servers' attentiveness, friendliness or rudeness, menu knowledge, recommendations, and how well they check on tables or handle complaints.

themes.name: Meal pacing
themes.description: Reviews about the timing of the meal, including long waits for food, courses arriving all at once, and being rushed through dinner or handed the check early.

themes.name: Reservations and seating
themes.description: Reviews about booking reservations, wait times to be seated, lost or delayed reservations, and how hosts handle walk-ins and seating.

themes.name: Dietary accommodations
themes.description: Reviews about vegetarian options, allergies, and substitution or modification requests, including how well the kitchen and staff handled them.

themes.name: Prices and portions
themes.description: Reviews about the cost of dishes and drinks, portion sizes, and whether the food is worth what it costs.

themes.name: Atmosphere and decor
themes.description: Reviews about the look and feel of the space, including decor, lighting, vibe, seating comfort, crowding, and the open kitchen.

themes.name: Noise level
themes.description: Reviews about how loud the restaurant is, including music volume and difficulty hearing dining companions or servers.

themes.name: Cocktails and drinks
themes.description: Reviews about cocktails, beer, wine, and other beverages, including quality, selection, strength, and price.

themes.name: Desserts
themes.description: Reviews about dessert offerings such as pineapple upside down cake, chocolate cake, puddings, and pies, including quality and availability.
